title: Aureline M5 protected-path row
description: Per-component contract for a protected-path row: the reusable component that names why a file or surface is guarded and how the protection is enforced. Binds the frozen governance-state vocabulary plus the enforcement authority (advisory, authoritative, provider_authoritative, or local_estimate) so an advisory owner hint never masquerades as provider-authoritative enforcement. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-review is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the shape. A protected-path row never leaves its protection reason or enforcement authority implicit.
